change_summary: Add phone-triggered CFB RUN IT workflow: CFBD + Open-Meteo capture, unmodified sportsedge_cfb_model.py projections and pricing for game lines and one-sided DK milestone props, ranked card with Central kickoff times and explicit withheld reasons. Fails closed on missing key, injury intake, FCS teams, started games, missing forecast and ambiguous player identity. Raw captures Fernet-encrypted; only sanitized card published.
assumptions: Model weights are untested; this PR does not change them.
SP+ is centred on captured file means as model input; input mapping, not a weight change.
One-sided DK milestone props use implied probability including vig as market p.
Player usage is derived from CFBD season totals; not validated predictively.

baseline.metric: Prospective untouched CFB forecast accuracy versus same-time market
